A Hoard of 3 silver Roman Denarii, dating to the period AD 141-161. Treasure number 2015 T921. 1. A silver Roman denarius of Faustina the Elder, dating to AD 141-161 (Reece period 7). AVGVSTA reverse type depicting Ceres standing right holding sceptre and corn ears. Mint of Rome. RIC Vol III, p.71, no. 358. Obverse description: Bust facing right.
